title: wg: protocol-06 §5.8 what is a 'handle' for MIMI users
description: draft-ietf-mimi-protocol-06 §5.8: handle = 'the entire handle URI matches exactly (for example: im:alice.smith@a.example)', with identifier formats deferred to I-D.mahy-mimi-identity (TODO). Problem: unclear whether a user's MIMI user URI (mimi://provider/u/id) counts as a handle, or only a separate handle URI scheme does; implementations will disagree on what an exact handle query matches. mimid: decision mimid-1wgh.7.39 (user URI is the handle). Suggested fix: say whether the MIMI user URI is a valid handle, or define handle by reference to the identity draft.
